7. CAUSE & NATURE OF ACCIDENT
—

As per instructions received from the insurer to conduct the final survey of the Insured Vehicle (I.V.) at the workshop, the undersigned has visited the Garage/Workshop & snapped few photos before and after dismantling the vehicle & carried out the survey. The Insured/Repairer has submitted the estimate for Rs. 27,140.00. After discussion with the Insured/Repairer, the loss has been finally assessed for Rs. 10,082.00, which is subject to the Policy Terms and Conditions. The loss has been worked out in detail as follows.
